title: Completed CONTRACT CLOSEOUT REPORT Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed CONTRACT CLOSEOUT REPORT artifact data payloads (PMO-07.02).

contract_identification.description: Record the contract reference, the vendor, and the contract type and value.

scope.description: Describe the aspects of contract scope that were handled well.

quality.description: Describe the aspects of product quality that were handled well.

schedule.description: Describe the aspects of the contract schedule that were handled well.

cost.description: Describe the aspects of the contract budget that were handled well.

other.description: Describe any other aspects of the contract or procurement that were handled well, including how easy the vendor was to work with.

scope.description: Describe the aspects of contract scope that could be improved.

quality.description: Describe the aspects of product quality that could be improved.

schedule.description: Describe the aspects of the contract schedule that could be improved.

cost.description: Describe the aspects of the contract budget that could be improved.

other.description: Describe any other aspects of the contract or procurement that could be improved.

change_id.description: Enter the change identifier from the change log.

change_description.description: Enter the description from the change log.

date_approved.description: Enter the date approved from the change log.

dispute_description.description: The dispute or claim, what was in contention, and the amount or scope at issue. State the position the project took and the date it was raised, because a dispute recorded without its date cannot be distinguished from one still open at closeout.

resolution.description: How the dispute was settled, by whom, and when, with a reference to the agreement or settlement that closed it. An unresolved dispute carried past closeout is a liability the receiving organisation inherits without knowing it, so record the outcome even when it is only partial.

date_resolved.description: Enter the date the dispute or claim was resolved.

contract_completion_date.description: The date the contract was completed, meaning the date the work was accepted rather than the date the last invoice was paid. Where the two differ, give both, because a payment date is not evidence that the work was accepted.

signed_off_by.description: Record who signed off on the contract completion.

final_payment_date.description: Enter the date of the final payment.

comments.description: Add any comments that will add relevance to the closeout report.
